## Why visit

A complete beer-and-food stop in a former canalside warehouse, with timber floors and cast-iron columns giving the room its character. The broad cask selection makes it worth considering even if you are sceptical of food-led pubs, and CAMRA also documents cider and perry served from the cellar. Its location between the railway station and central Chester is particularly useful when arranging arrival or departure around a meal. Pair with That Beer Place and the Brewery Tap for three genuinely different Chester experiences: specialist cider bar, historic hall and comfortable canalside pub.
